title: Hamuul Runetotem
wikitext:
{{Stub}}[[Image:Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem.jpg|right]] Arch Druid [[Hamuul Runetotem]] is a level 62 [[quest giver]] located on [[Elder Rise]] in the [[tauren]] city of [[Thunder Bluff]]. == Lore == Hamuul Runetotem met [[Malfurion Stormrage]] during the recent invasion of the [[Burning Legion]] and befriended him. The [[night elf]] instructed the tauren, awakening an innate affinity for [[druid (lore)|druid]]ism. Despite opposition from some night elves, such as [[Fandral Staghelm]], Runetotem became the first individual belonging to a non-elven race to be accepted as a member of the [[Cenarion Circle]]. He shared his wisdom with his tauren brethren and thus reintroduced the knowledge of the druids, which had been forgotten for eons, to his people. Hamuul has a daughter, [[Bashana Runetotem|Bashana]], who is a Cenarion Circle member like her father. There was also a Tauren chieftain called Taur Runetotem that helped the Horde during the Third War.
